og.alt: Sync: Same signal. Now it's multiplayer, and it works offline. 59 ns to take in an inbound WebSocket frame on the transport's fast path.

hero.alt: Schematic: a laptop and a phone share one synced list through a WebSocket relay. The phone goes offline and adds coffee, saved to IndexedDB; the laptop adds bread. When the phone reconnects, both edits merge through the relay and both lists show milk, eggs, bread and coffee. Then the two items are removed and the removal syncs too.
